evals.prompt: Probe the 100 newest awwwards black-and-white winners, give each a site type, and give me an overview of the set.
evals.expected_output: design-research/sites.json, one folder per site with styles.json, overview.md and screenshot.jpg, and design-research/README.md built by --index.
assertions: Sites come from /websites/black-and-white/ and each carries an SOTD, SOTM, SOTY or HM badge
Every overview.md has a colour palette, a type scale, spacing values and a section table
Every overview.md has a Type from the skill's type list and no _TODO_ placeholder
Every hex colour quoted in a Character paragraph appears in that site's styles.json
Failed and partial captures are named in the report rather than silently counted
README.md type counts match the Type lines in the overviews

evals.prompt: What fonts and colours does https://example.com use?
evals.expected_output: One probe run on that URL and a short answer quoting the measured palette and type scale.
assertions: Runs probe.mjs on the given URL only, without visiting awwwards
Answer quotes hex colours and font families that appear in styles.json

evals.prompt: Make canada-clock look like the Grail site.
evals.expected_output: Treated as a frontend change, not a design probe; the skill is at most used to read Grail's measured tokens.
assertions: Does not treat the probe output as the deliverable
Does not copy Grail's text, images or fonts into the repo

evals.prompt: Add 15 portfolio sites from SiteInspire to our design research and measure them.
evals.expected_output: A vetted link list appended to design-research/sites.json with --add, only the new sites measured, each with Type and Character filled in.
assertions: Uses --links on a SiteInspire list page and removes sponsor or tool links before adding
Uses --add so existing ranks are unchanged and duplicates are skipped
Runs --batch on the master list and only unmeasured sites are probed
New styles.json files carry listing.source and listing.listing
fixture_requirements: Network access, Google Chrome, an existing design-research folder
